result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one content defect stands out: the promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−100%', an implausible discount value. No other clear visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and the cut-off bottom card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays '−100%', which is an implausible discount (everything free). It is likely a data or formatting bug, e.g. a wrong value or a miscalculated percentage, and could mislead users.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data source and the percentage calculation and formatting. Validate promo values against a sensible range (e.g. 5–70%) and hide the badge when the value is invalid.
